crossRefs.note: Then his wife said to him, “Do you still maintain your integrity? Renounce God, and die.”
But he said to her, “You speak as one of the foolish women would speak. What? Shall we receive good at the hand of God…
“My spirit is consumed. My days are extinct, and the grave is ready for me.

translations.web: My breath is offensive to my wife. I am loathsome to the children of my own mother.
translations.bsb: My breath is repulsive to my wife, and I am loathsome to my own family.
translations.kjv: My breath is strange to my wife, though I intreated for the children's sake of mine own body.
translations.asv: My breath is strange to my wife, And my supplication to the children of mine own mother.
